obligation: DFARS 252.204-7012 Safeguarding Covered Defense Information and Cyber Incident Reporting
basis: The clause is in all current subcontracts with Prime A, Prime B and Prime C, and the company receives and creates covered defense information (controlled technical information) for them. No size exemption; flowdown to suppliers that receive covered defense information (252.204-7012(m))

obligation: CMMC Program rule (32 CFR Part 170) and DFARS 252.204-7021
applies: Not in current subcontracts; Level 2 (C3PAO) prepared for as a voluntary choice while Phase 2 is suspended
basis: Current subcontracts predate 2025-11-10 and do not include the clause. All three primes notified suppliers that solicitations from 2026-11-10 would flow down Level 2 (C3PAO). The DoD (Department of War) CIO memorandum of 2026-07-13 suspends Phase 2; until 2028-11-09 the clause is included only when a program office requires a specific level (DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0025, Revision 3). If a prime contract requires Level 2 (C3PAO), 32 CFR 170.23(a)(3) makes it the minimum for a subcontractor handling CUI. No size exemption

obligation: DFARS 252.204-7019 and 252.204-7020 NIST SP 800-171 DoD Assessment (SPRS)
basis: Both clauses are in the current subcontracts; a current Basic Assessment score must be in SPRS (74 posted 2025-06-12 for the Plant 1 and cloud scope), and assessments must be checked for suppliers ((g))

obligation: FAR 52.204-21 Basic Safeguarding of Covered Contractor Information Systems
basis: The clause is in the current subcontracts, and FCI (DoD purchase order data) resides in the ERP and corporate systems
The company is registered with DDTC (22 CFR 122.1), and Prime A and Prime B parts are ITAR defense articles whose technical data the company holds
Customer D and Customer E parts carry EAR-controlled technology; 2 foreign-national engineers work in the commercial engineering group
No facility clearance and no classified work in any contract

obligation: Covered telecommunications and video surveillance equipment
basis: The clause is in the current subcontracts; report within 1 business day of identifying covered equipment ((d))
The controlled technical information the company handles is CUI Basic, protected at no less than moderate confidentiality (2002.14(a)(3))
The current subcontracts keep FAR 52.204-21 and 52.204-25 and DFARS 252.204-7019 and -7020 until modified; new awards under a class deviation would carry the new numbers

obligation: Additive and engineering services agreements (3 commercial customers)
basis: Confidentiality of customer files, turnaround commitments, notice within 72 hours of confirming a security incident affecting customer data, and a SOC 2 Type 2 report by 2027-12-31
The company holds personal information of employees and applicants in Florida, and the payroll, HR and applicant tracking vendor is a third-party agent

obligation: Breach notification laws of other states
citation: The law of each state where affected individuals reside
basis: Applies when a breach affects employees or applicants who live outside Florida
The company has 850 employees and recruits with an applicant tracking system that includes a ranking feature
The final rule is not published; nothing is required yet
No health or payment card data beyond employee records
